provenance.note: Extruded massing only. Building heights are 3D-GloBFP model estimates, not surveyed heights. The two Spring Cocoon stadium outlines come from OSM building=stadium with the OSM height tag (40m). The two Tencent Seafront Towers come from OSM way/694152192 (South Tower, 245.8m) and way/694152193 (North Tower, 194.8m), both OSM height tags, not surveys. Surface roads use inferred widths; no terrain or grade separation. Street furniture is procedural, not a surveyed layout. Water is a background plane and is not collidable. Combined derived data retains ODbL obligations.
provenance.landmarkEvidence: CTBUH building record lists China Resources Tower at 392.5m; OSM way/529272473 supplies the 37-point outline (building:levels 68). Architectural height, not an exact roof model.
provenance.osmLandmarkReference: 3 OSM landmark outlines retained as reference (way/529272473 added as ctbuh massing). 4 OSM building outlines added as ordinary estimate massing (way/665408865, way/665408866, way/694152192, way/694152193, OSM height tags).
